findings.claim: The `#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK` guard drops the attribute for netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework consumers, so their generated formatters are not decorated. The acceptance criterion 'All generated code is decorated' is therefore not met for some of the most common MessagePack consumers.
